checks.name: 1. The bottom clip alone and the top clip at opacity 1 are byte-identical to their files
2. Normal blend, opacities 0.01…0.99: every byte within 1 of round(exact at round(255·α)/255)
3. multiply, screen, overlay, soft-light, darken, lighten, add at 14 opacities: every byte within 1 of round(exact at round(255·α)/255)

4. Dissolve at 21 progress values (one of them 0.5), between two clips and revealing over the track below: every byte within 1 of round(exact at round(255·p)/255); between two clips a byte that is the same in both pictures is unchanged
5. Draft, a faded picture: normal blend at 99 opacities every byte within 2 of round(exact at α), mean signed error within ±0.1; with multiply … add (14 opacities each) byte-identical to full
6. Draft, the dissolve at 21 progress values (between two clips, revealing): every byte within 2 of round(exact at p), mean within ±0.1; between two clips same-value bytes unchanged
7. Draft against full on all those frames: at most 2 apart byte by byte; the lab's full frame equals the still (normal blend, opacity 0.37)
8. The fill limited to the faded picture's placed box equals the fill of the whole buffer byte for byte (54 drawings: 9 placements × 2 opacities × 3 frame sizes)

checks.name: 9. Title opacity (11 opacities incl. 0, 0.5, 1; plain, without and with a fade-in half way; full and draft): solid and antialiased edge pixels within 3 levels and mean bias within ±0.75, pixels outside the glyphs within 1, of the exact mix of the title's opaque rendering at the nearest 8-bit alpha (stroked title recorded, not gated)

10. Time-effect taps (echo blend 2 to 5 taps at decay 0.6 and 0.9 at opacities 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25; lighten and trail at 1; full and draft): every byte within 3 levels and the mean bias within ±0.75 of the exact weighted mix

11. Zoom transition at 9 progress values (between two clips, revealing; full and draft): every byte within 3 levels and each case's mean bias within ±0.75 of the exact mix of the outgoing and the scaled incoming picture at the nearest 8-bit alphas

12. Blur-dissolve at 9 progress values (between two clips, revealing; full and draft): every byte within 3 levels and each case's mean bias within ±0.75 of the exact mix of the two blurred pictures (the product's own blur) at the nearest 8-bit alphas
13. Punch-in smear (four quarter-strength scaled copies added; full and draft), gated loosely: within 4 levels of the mean of the four copies, bias within ±0.8

taps.reference: exact mix (1 − aq)·picture below + aq·Σ (W_k/4096)·P_k of the tap pictures P_k recomputed here (lighten: max_k decay^k·P_k; trail with an opaque newest picture: P_0), aq = round(255·opacity)/255

zoom, between two clips.reference: out·(1 − p) + scaledIn·p; scaledIn = the incoming picture scaled by 1.3 − 0.3p about the centre with the same canvas call as the kernel

zoom, revealing over the track below.reference: out·(1 − p) + scaledIn·p; scaledIn = the incoming picture scaled by 1.3 − 0.3p about the centre with the same canvas call as the kernel

blur-dissolve, between two clips.reference: softOut·(1 − p) + softIn·p (revealing: the picture below stands for the outgoing side, unblurred); soft = the kernel's own blur recipe at blurRadius(p)

blur-dissolve, revealing over the track.reference: softOut·(1 − p) + softIn·p (revealing: the picture below stands for the outgoing side, unblurred); soft = the kernel's own blur recipe at blurRadius(p)

punchIn.note: punch-in (the other transition kernel that adds scaled pictures with globalAlpha): four copies of one side at 0.25 added with lighter
